verdict.rationale: Publishing processing times is a fair question for an IP office, so the axis applies. The evidence shows per-application status tracking, hearing cause lists, controller's decisions and fee schedules. None of it shows IP India publishing current processing or pendency times for any transaction type. Per-application status lookup is an adjacent feature and does not count as published service-level timing.

support.subject: As a founder, current processing times for my transaction type are published by the service itself
